answer: An agent market requires every identity to lock a refundable bond before bidding on jobs; proven double-signing of conflicting delivery receipts burns that bond. Whether agents trade at a harbor, on a mesa, or near an oasis, creating new names cannot create collateral. An attacker running 1,000 eligible identities must fund 1,000 bonds, forgo other uses of that capital while it is locked, and lose a bond for each identity caught double-signing.
